title: NVIDIA announces 250 million dollar compute commitment for UK research
excerpt: The five-year investment provides annual accelerated computing access to researchers at the University of Oxford, UCL and Imperial College London.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on October 13, 2026, a five-year, 250 million dollar compute commitment to strengthen agentic safety and security research in the United Kingdom. The company said this commitment provides 50 million dollars in accelerated computing access annually through BOLD at the University of Oxford, SOFAIR at UCL and Imperial College London.

In addition to the research commitment, NVIDIA is partnering with the Earthshot Prize. The company is joining as a Global Alliance Founding Partner to bring compute and technical expertise to innovators working on solutions for climate and sustainability challenges.

NVIDIA also reported that more than 3,100 U.K. companies are part of the NVIDIA Inception program for startups. NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang is scheduled to present a keynote address at GTC Berlin on Wednesday, Oct. 21, at 11 a.m. CEST.
topic: From Enterprise to Earthshot: UK’s Ecosystem Moves From Ambition to Application With NVIDIA
